### Why Multi-Branch Businesses Face a Unique Verification Challenge


When your business operates from 5, 20, or 100+ branches, across cities, states, or even countries, employee verification stops being a simple HR task and becomes a **coordination nightmare** .


Here is what goes wrong when branch managers hire independently without a centralised verification process:


**Inconsistent standards across locations.** Your Mumbai branch runs thorough checks; your Tier-2 city branch skips them entirely because “we know everyone here.” According to[AuthBridge’s Workforce Fraud Files 2026](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) , **4.33% of white-collar hires** and **5.61% of gig hires** show discrepancies, and the[retail sector alone shows a 10.3% discrepancy rate](https://www.storyboard18.com/how-it-works/fake-tenures-forged-degrees-retail-sector-sees-10-3-hiring-discrepancy-rate-80687.htm) , with 1 in 6 employment checks failing. Multi-branch retail, QSR, and franchise businesses are disproportionately affected.


**No visibility across branches.** Head office has no way to know which branches have completed verification, which checks are pending, or which new hires were flagged. As[OnGrid notes](https://ongrid.in/blogs/?p=8154) , rapid hiring across many cities tracked through email and spreadsheets makes it impossible to know verification status in real time.


**Compliance risk multiplies.** Under the[Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023](https://www.meity.gov.in/data-protection-framework) , every single check at every single branch requires documented consent, data masking, and audit trails. One branch that skips consent is a liability for the entire company.


**Branch managers are not verification experts.** They are operations people, store managers, or franchise owners. They need a tool that any non-specialist can use in minutes, not an enterprise platform that requires training, sales calls, and account managers.

## #2 AuthBridge iBridge — Best Enterprise Platform for Multi-Location Operations


**Pricing:** Custom enterprise | **Rating:** 4.5/5


AuthBridge’s iBridge platform is India’s most comprehensive multi-location verification solution, with 140+ integrations, 600+ court district coverage, and field agents across India. Their enterprise dashboard provides head-office visibility into verification status across all branches. According to their[Workforce Fraud Files 2026](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) , the retail sector shows a 10.3% discrepancy rate — making multi-branch retail one of the highest-risk segments for hiring fraud.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You operate 50+ branches, hire 1,000+ people/year across locations, need comprehensive coverage (criminal, education, field verification), and have enterprise budget with a dedicated HR team at head office.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** AuthBridge offers the deepest coverage with branch-level enterprise controls. But it requires sales engagement, custom pricing, and 2–7 day turnaround. For the instant identity and employment checks that every branch needs, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 is faster and self-serve.


## #3 SpringVerify — Best HRMS-Integrated Tool for Multi-Branch HR Teams


**Pricing:** Rs. 799–Rs. 1,599/candidate | **Rating:** 4/5


SpringVerify integrates natively with Darwinbox, greytHR, Keka, and other Indian HRMS platforms. For multi-branch companies that use a centralised HRMS, this means verification triggers automatically when any branch adds a new hire — no manual initiation needed. Published pricing starts at Rs. 799 per candidate. The real-time tracking dashboard lets head office monitor verification progress at every branch.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You use a centralised Indian HRMS (Darwinbox, greytHR, Keka) across all branches and want verification to trigger automatically from your existing system, with published pricing.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** SpringVerify’s HRMS automation removes the need for branch managers to initiate checks manually — a significant advantage for standardisation. But at Rs. 799–Rs. 1,599 vs. Rs. 499 per candidate, and 2–5 day turnaround vs. under 2 minutes, SalaryBox Verify wins on cost and speed for branches that need instant results.


## #4 OnGrid — Best API Platform for Custom Multi-Branch Pipelines


**Pricing:** Custom per-call | **Rating:** 4/5


OnGrid offers 200+ check types via API with EPFO, DigiLocker, eFIR, Aadhaar, and PAN integration. For multi-branch companies with a tech team, OnGrid’s APIs can be embedded into a custom branch-level onboarding system, so verification runs automatically as part of each branch’s hiring workflow. According to their remote hiring blog, centralised tracking is essential when hiring across 50+ cities simultaneously.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You have an in-house developer team that can build branch-level verification into your own custom ATS or onboarding system, and want DigiLocker education verification alongside identity checks.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** OnGrid’s API flexibility enables custom multi-branch workflows that SalaryBox Verify’s dashboard cannot match. But it requires developer resources and custom pricing. For branches without tech support, SalaryBox Verify’s self-serve dashboard is immediately usable.


## #5 IDfy — Best AI Verification for Remote Multi-Branch Onboarding


**Pricing:** Custom enterprise | **Rating:** 3.5/5


IDfy’s AI-powered liveness detection and face matching are particularly valuable for multi-branch businesses that onboard employees remotely — where a new hire at a distant branch submits documents digitally and no one from head office is physically present to confirm their identity. IDfy processes 100M+ verifications annually and integrates with 6+ government databases. According to[IndiaAI](https://indiaai.gov.in/article/idfy-deploys-ai-to-detect-fraud-and-clear-the-fog-of-deceptiveness) , their AI prevents identity swaps that simple database checks cannot catch.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You onboard employees remotely at branches without dedicated HR presence, and need liveness verification to ensure the person submitting documents is physically the same person who will show up to work.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** IDfy’s liveness detection prevents identity swaps at remote branches. But for standard PAN + DL + employment checks, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 delivers the same government-verified results in minutes, without enterprise pricing.


## #6 HireRight — Best for Multi-Country Branch Operations


**Pricing:** Custom premium | **Rating:** 3.5/5


HireRight is a global screening provider with SAP SuccessFactors and Oracle Taleo integrations, making it the natural choice for companies operating branches across India and internationally. According to their[2026 India report](https://www.hireright.com/blog/indias-hiring-landscape-2026-employment-risk-identity-fraud-ai-shift) , **74% of Indian employers** found identity fraud during hiring. Their global dashboard provides unified reporting across India, Southeast Asia, EMEA, and North America.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You operate branches across multiple countries, use SAP/Oracle HRMS, and need consistent international screening standards with unified global reporting.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** HireRight’s global reach is unmatched for international multi-branch operations. But for India-only branches, SalaryBox Verify delivers government-verified results in minutes at Rs. 499 — without the enterprise infrastructure and 3–10 day wait.


## #7 BetterPlace verifyBetter — Best for Multi-Branch Frontline Workforce


**Pricing:** Custom enterprise | **Rating:** 3.5/5


BetterPlace is purpose-built for companies with multiple branches hiring frontline workers — retail chains, logistics networks, QSR franchises, and facility management companies. Their WhatsApp-based verification flow lets blue-collar workers at any branch complete document submission and consent from their phone. AI-powered criminal record screening covers pan-India court jurisdictions. The manage Better ATS provides branch-level hiring and verification tracking.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You operate a retail chain, logistics network, or franchise system hiring hundreds of frontline workers across branches monthly, and need WhatsApp-based verification that works for tech-limited workers.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** BetterPlace’s WhatsApp flow and AI criminal screening are ideal for large frontline operations. But for the core identity checks (PAN, DL), SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 is faster, transparent on pricing, and works for any branch size.


## #8 HelloVerify — Best Budget Option for Multi-Branch SMBs


**Pricing:** Rs. 1,799+/package | **Rating:** 3/5


HelloVerify offers comprehensive verification packages at lower-than-enterprise pricing, making it accessible for multi-branch SMBs that need criminal and education checks alongside identity verification. Their traffic-light reporting (Suspect/Alert/Good-to-Go) is designed for branch managers who are not HR specialists. According to[HROne’s comparison](https://content.hrone.cloud/?p=56763) , packages start around Rs. 1,799.


**Best for multi-branch when:** You run 5–25 branches, need comprehensive checks (including criminal and education) at each location, and want visual traffic-light reports that non-HR branch managers can act on.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** HelloVerify bundles criminal and education checks in one package. But at Rs. 1,799+ vs. Rs. 499, it’s 3.5x more expensive per candidate, and the 24–72 hour turnaround means branch hires wait overnight. For instant identity and employment checks, SalaryBox Verify is faster and cheaper across all branches.

### 8. What compliance risks do multi-branch businesses face with verification?


The **Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023** requires documented consent, data masking, and audit trails for every single verification check. A single branch that skips consent is a compliance liability for the entire company. Using a platform like SalaryBox Verify that automates consent collection and produces timestamped PDF reports ensures every branch is compliant automatically.
